facts.text: John mentioned that a picture of his family, taken during a trip for his daughter Sara's birthday last year, serves as a motivator for him.

evidence.quote: That picture was from a trip we took last year for my daughter Sara's birthday - so much fun and good memories!
Here's a picture of my family. They motivate me and remind me why I'm doing this.

facts.text: John stated that his family is a key source of motivation and helps him stay on track during difficult times.

evidence.quote: My family motivates me to keep striving for change.
My family is my motivation and they keep me going.
